ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_check IS
 V_CURRENT_RECORD NUMBER := 0;
 V_LAST_RECORD NUMBER := 0;
 V_ALERT_NO NUMBER := 0;
 v_WAREHOUSE_ID VALID_WAREHOUSE_USERS.WAREHOUSE_ID%type;
 v_CHAPTER_ID VALID_WAREHOUSE_USERS.CHAPTER_ID%type;
 
BEGIN
 IF NVL(:CTRL_BLOCK.CHECK_DUPLICATE,'N') = 'Y' THEN
 /* Setting Flag to N so that it would not get fire again until validated once 
 again */
 :CTRL_BLOCK.CHECK_DUPLICATE := 'N';
 V_CURRENT_RECORD := TO_NUMBER(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('VALID_WAREHOUSE_USERS',CURRENT_RECORD));
 v_WAREHOUSE_ID := :VALID_WAREHOUSE_USERS.WAREHOUSE_ID;
 v_CHAPTER_ID := :VALID_WAREHOUSE_USERS.CHAPTER_ID;
 GO_BLOCK('VALID_WAREHOUSE_USERS');
 LAST_RECORD;
 V_LAST_RECORD := TO_NUMBER(GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('VALID_WAREHOUSE_USERS',CURRENT_RECORD));
 FIRST_RECORD;
 FOR V_INDEX IN 1..V_LAST_RECORD
 LOOP
 IF V_INDEX != V_CURRENT_RECORD AND
 v_WAREHOUSE_ID = :VALID_WAREHOUSE_USERS.WAREHOUSE_ID AND
 v_CHAPTER_ID = :VALID_WAREHOUSE_USERS.CHAPTER_ID THEN
 --V_DATA = :PHONES.PHO_TYPE THEN
 go_record(v_current_record);
 --set_alert_property('ALERT_STOP',ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, 'Duplicate Record.');
 --V_ALERT_NO := show_alert('ALERT_STOP');
 show_error('0069'); -- tmppp
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 EXIT;
 END IF;
 If :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD!='TRUE' then 
 NEXT_RECORD;
 End If; 
 END LOOP;
 go_record(v_current_record);--tmppp
 END IF;
END;
